description: Andhra Pradesh Police Advances Smart Policing With AI Tools
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh Police Introduces New Digital Tools Andhra Pradesh Police Advances Smart Policing With AI Tools: The Andhra Pradesh Police has strengthened technology-driven policing by launching two digital initiatives in Guntur on September 22, 2026. The Centralised Drone Monitoring Portal (CDMP) and SafeStay AP application are designed to improve surveillance, field intelligence and preventive policing. The initiatives were launched by DGP Harish Kumar Gupta in collaboration with Guntur Superintendent of Police Vakul Jindal.
